STOP NOTICE – WGJ ENTERPRISES, INC. DBA PCI

(C-140920, Communication No. 122743 - Filed September 16, 2026)
summary: Stop notice in the amount of $49,973.79 from WGJ Enterprises, Inc. for highway safety improvement program striping and markings work.
